column1: # Transmission effects for the policies in policies.yaml. One row is one effect
# and the policy column says which policy it belongs to. A row with no policy
# applies to any policy that reads this file.
#   transmission_mode   a mode named in disease.yaml
#   filter.*            who or what the row applies to
#                       person row can filter on age
#                       venue row can filter on venue_type
#                       properties of the venue. An empty cell matches anything.
# All matching rows of all active policies multiply together. Two rows that
# match the same people or venues under one policy are rejected as duplicates.
# Venue effects need a temporal policy with compliance_rate 1.
